# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.rye/shims/rye
# args: 
Helper utility to manage Python toolchains

Usage: rye toolchain <COMMAND>

Commands:
  fetch     Fetches a Python interpreter for the local machine
  list      List all registered toolchains
  register  Register a Python binary
  remove    Removes a toolchain
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
